a.text: Concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take 4 each) leaves us both likely dead after round 1 with empty units. The reserve's 4 cells can save only one of us right now. I'd rather renegotiate openly than break the deal quietly. Proposal: whoever takes, we're transparent about it, and if the episode continues, the taker operates every remaining round and never takes more. Do you see a fairer option? I'll tell you my real next action plainly.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep the agreement and operate. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: I will take my 4 cells when the reserve holds 8.
